_meta.note: Team analyst mapping of this project's CVEs to MITRE ATT&CK (Enterprise) and of decisions to NIST CSF 2.0. It is NOT an official MITRE or NIST mapping. Identifiers and names were checked against attack.mitre.org and NIST CSWP 29.

T1027.009.name: Obfuscated Files or Information: Embedded Payloads

T1499.004.name: Endpoint Denial of Service: Application or System Exploitation

CVE-2014-0160.rationale: Crafted heartbeat requests to an exposed TLS service leak memory that can hold credentials and keys.

CVE-2016-2183.rationale: An attacker positioned on the network collects long 64-bit block cipher traffic to recover plaintext.

CVE-2017-0144.rationale: Remote code execution over SMBv1, used to move between hosts.

CVE-2019-0708.rationale: Pre-authentication remote code execution over Remote Desktop.

CVE-2019-11687.rationale: An executable hidden in a DICOM file preamble runs if the file is executed.

CVE-2019-12256.rationale: Network-reachable stack overflow in the embedded device TCP/IP stack.

CVE-2019-19781.rationale: Unauthenticated code execution on an internet-facing remote access gateway.

CVE-2020-11896.rationale: Network-reachable remote code execution in the embedded Treck TCP/IP stack.

CVE-2020-1472.rationale: A Netlogon flaw lets a network attacker take domain administrator privileges.

CVE-2021-21972.rationale: Remote code execution against the vCenter management interface.

CVE-2021-22005.rationale: Arbitrary file upload leading to code execution on vCenter.

CVE-2021-26855.rationale: Server-side request forgery on an exposed Exchange server.

CVE-2021-34527.rationale: Print Spooler allows privilege escalation and remote code execution.

CVE-2021-4034.rationale: Local privilege escalation to root through pkexec.

CVE-2021-44228.rationale: A JNDI lookup gives remote code execution in services that log attacker input.

CVE-2022-0778.rationale: A crafted certificate causes an infinite loop and denial of service.

CVE-2022-22965.rationale: Remote code execution in a web application through data binding.

CVE-2022-26134.rationale: Unauthenticated OGNL injection on a Confluence server.

CVE-2022-30190.rationale: A malicious document invokes MSDT to run code on the client.

CVE-2022-40684.rationale: Authentication bypass on the firewall or VPN administrative interface.

CVE-2023-20198.rationale: An exposed web UI lets an unauthenticated attacker create a privileged account.

CVE-2023-23397.rationale: A crafted Outlook item makes the client send its NTLM hash to an attacker.

CVE-2023-34362.rationale: SQL injection on an exposed file transfer application.

CVE-2023-36884.rationale: A crafted Office document delivered by phishing executes code.

CVE-2023-38545.rationale: A malicious server response overflows a buffer in the curl client.

CVE-2023-44487.rationale: HTTP/2 stream resets exhaust server resources.

CVE-2023-48795.rationale: A man-in-the-middle truncates the SSH handshake to weaken the session.

CVE-2024-21762.rationale: Out-of-bounds write on the internet-facing SSL VPN.

CVE-2024-3400.rationale: Command injection on the internet-facing GlobalProtect gateway.

CVE-2024-6387.rationale: A race condition gives remote code execution in the SSH server.

csf.ID.RA-01: Vulnerabilities in assets are identified, validated, and recorded
csf.ID.RA-05: Threats, vulnerabilities, likelihoods, and impacts are used to understand inherent risk and inform risk response prioritization
csf.ID.RA-06: Risk responses are chosen, prioritized, planned, tracked, and communicated
csf.ID.RA-07: Changes and exceptions are managed, assessed for risk impact, recorded, and tracked
csf.PR.PS-02: Software is maintained, replaced, and removed commensurate with risk
csf.PR.IR-01: Networks and environments are protected from unauthorized logical access and usage
csf.DE.CM-01: Networks and network services are monitored to find potentially adverse events
csf.DE.CM-09: Computing hardware and software, runtime environments, and their data are monitored to find potentially adverse events
